items.exampleEn: The city has more canals than roads.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市的運河比馬路還多。

items.exampleEn: Life was hard for the early settlers.
items.exampleZh: 早期移民的生活很辛苦。

items.exampleEn: This small island is a safe haven for sea birds.
items.exampleZh: 這座小島是海鳥安全的棲息地。

items.exampleEn: The harbor is full of small boats.
Always use the crossing when you walk across the road.
items.exampleZh: 過馬路一定要走行人穿越道。

items.exampleEn: We drove to a northwestern town for the weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我們週末開車去西北部的一個小鎮。

items.exampleEn: This book gives geographical information about each city.
items.exampleZh: 這本書提供每座城市的地理資訊。

items.exampleEn: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
items.exampleZh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

items.sentenceEn: Many old houses stand along the canal.
items.sentenceZh: 許多老房子沿著運河而立。

items.audioEn: The bus stop for the harbor is next to the crossing near the bakery.
items.audioZh: 往港口的公車站在麵包店附近的穿越道旁邊。
items.questionZh: 往港口的公車站在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: The emperor's palace is now a museum.
items.sentenceZh: 皇帝的宮殿現在是博物館。

items.sentenceEn: Ships wait outside the harbor in bad weather.
items.sentenceZh: 天氣不好時，船會在港外等候。

items.stemEn: Boats carry goods along the ____ between the two cities.
items.stemZh: 船沿著兩座城市之間的運河運送貨物。

items.stemEn: Students study maps to learn ____ facts about the world.
items.stemZh: 學生研讀地圖來學習關於世界的地理知識。

items.passageEn: Long ago, settlers came to this northwestern coast and built a small harbor. Later, they dug a canal to carry goods to towns further from the sea. An emperor once visited and called the place "a haven of peace." Today, a crossing near the harbor helps people walk safely to the canal, which is a popular place for photos. Fishing boats still bring fresh fish to the harbor every morning, and restaurants nearby serve it at lunch.
items.passageZh: 很久以前，移民來到這片西北海岸，建了一座小港口。後來他們挖了一條運河，把貨物運到離海較遠的城鎮。曾有一位皇帝來訪，稱這裡是「和平的避風港」。如今，港口附近有一條行人穿越道，讓人可以安全走到運河邊，那裡是熱門的拍照地點。漁船仍然每天早上把新鮮的魚運到港口，附近的餐廳在午餐時供應。

questions.questionZh: 皇帝怎麼形容這個地方？

items.promptZh: 漁船每天傍晚回到港口。
referenceEn: Fishing boats return to the harbor every evening.
The fishing boats come back to the harbor each evening.
rubricZh: harbor 表示「港口」（英式拼法 harbour）
「回到」可寫，例如 return to、come back to 等
時態配合內容（說習慣多用現在簡單式）

referenceEn: He became emperor when he was only ten.
He became emperor at the age of ten.
rubricZh: 用 emperor 表示「皇帝」（例如 became emperor；寫 became the emperor 也正確）
「十歲」可寫，例如 when he was ten、at the age of ten 等
